advisory_notes: The source states the leadership composition only partially; the Rules provide for one Chairperson and two Members, so the note should avoid implying a complete leadership team from one Member's appointment.[6][7]
The official source supports the Act and Rules framework, but the proposed analysis of autonomy, safeguards, and accountability should remain explicitly analytical rather than factual.[1][2][6]
The phrase 'beginning the functioning' in the pocket-read deck is a mild inference; the source establishes assumption of office, not the Board's operational performance.
'India's apex central authority' is the source's description, but the statutory wording supports calling it the central authority for recognition and compliance more precisely.[1][6]
The hypothetical example is appropriately labelled and does not assert an actual recognition proceeding; retain the explicit caveat that procedure, timeline, and appeals are unspecified.
